why: What Thornswood-Last.esp leaves alone, the mod quests it stops as well, and the places it gives a hold. Patrick, 12 Oct 2026: every vanilla quest can be cut. His answers the same evening to the eight decisions on issue 2468 were 'all recommended': the barter, carriage, follower, courier and start-up quests are stopped with the rest, the creature voices and the authored corpses stay, and the sixteen mod quests with gate, door or arrival talk are stopped too.

corpses.why: The 1,361 authored corpses (startsDead) are cut from the living population, but they never flashed: the client's world cleaner leaves a dead placed actor where it lies, so they stand as scenery. Patrick, 12 Oct 2026: keep them as scenery (decision 7 on issue 2468).

questEditorIdPrefixesKept.CreatureDialogue: creature voices: the growls, barks and calls of the animals and creatures Thornswood keeps (Patrick, 12 Oct 2026, decision 6 on issue 2468)

questScriptProperties.why: Script properties set on a mod quest, each the winning record with only these values added or changed on its script. Skyrim Unbound's start (SkyrimUnboundQuestScript.PrepareForStart, then the inventory module's GivePlayerStuff) runs in each person's own game and hands the new character a random weapon, equipped, and can hand out random spells. The server never gives them, so the weapon hangs on the hip with nothing in the inventory, invisible, and can still be drawn and swung (issue 3101; read by Djinn on 16 Oct 2026 out of the compiled scripts, issue 2039). Patrick, 21 Oct 2026, on the board review (issue 3192): the fix goes in this plugin. It has to be here, not in Thornswood-Content.esp, because Skyrim Unbound.esp loads after the content plugin and its own record would win there.

properties.name: ChoiceRandomWeapons
properties.why: True (the script's default) picks a random weapon and equips it. False takes the weapon only from ChoiceOneHanded, ChoiceOneHandedCombination, ChoiceTwoHanded, ChoiceRanged and ChoiceStaff, which all default to 0, and 0 gives none.

properties.name: ChoiceSpellsMode
properties.why: 0 (the default) can hand out random spells, more likely when no weapon was given, which would leave the same kind of spell in a hand that only that game knows. 1 returns before any spell is given.

placeHolds.why: Patrick, 17 Oct 2026, decision 2 = B on issue 2551: the places on Tamriel's ground that Skyrim and the collection's mods put in no hold get one, so the Steward and Jarl of that hold settle their buildings and the main menu's last location names the hold. Apocrypha, the Soul Cairn, Sovngarde, the Forgotten Vale, Misty Grove and the test and Creation Club cells stay in no hold. A location is given its hold, or the place of Patrick's list it lies in, as its parent; a room with no location of its own is given the location of the place it belongs to, or the hold's own when no location covers it.

locations.place: Dead Drop Falls and Dead Drop Mine, caves of Fort Dawnguard's valley
locations.why: Their doors open onto the valley, and Dawnguard.esm gives their location Tamriel as its parent, not the valley's.

cells.why: The room has no location of its own. It takes Oar's Rest's, which OarsRest.esp already puts in Falkreath Hold.
The hut has no location of its own and no location of Solitude Arena.esp covers it, so it takes the Reach's own.

cells.place: Mossy Glen Cave, a cave of Fort Dawnguard's valley
cells.why: The cave has no location of its own. Its doors open onto the valley, so it takes the valley's.

notCopiedFrom.why: Immersive Armors. Patrick, 17 Oct 2026 (issue 2454): it is used as-is through the collection and nothing built from it is redistributed. So no record of it is copied here, none carried (Patrick, 22 Oct 2026, report page q-613-ia-recipes: he never allowed the floor items to be carried either). A cell it wins is copied from the plugin below it when it changes nothing there (issue 3077). A floor item it places, and a floor item or cut actor standing in a cell or world it wins, is held off by the server instead (HELD_BY_SERVER in game/gamemode.js), and its re-costed recipes are set in each person's game (RECIPES_SET_IN_GAME, issue 613).

holdOnly.why: Patrick, 22 Oct 2026, page answer A on #3150: each hold has 2 to 3 hold-only plants, ores or animals, which grow only in their own hold (his words: 'they only spawn within that hold ... if you are in that hold you can just grab it but not while in a differnet hod'). Every placed one outside its hold is switched off (scripts/mods/Build-LastPlugin.py, step 8). Which ones is measured, not guessed: for each hold, the plants and ores whose placements already stand mostly in it, so the fewest are switched off and the world keeps the shape its authors gave it. A plant or ore with no hold among the nine as its largest share was left out. No animal: every animal kind in the catalogue stands in four or more holds (game/data/npc-population.json, 26 Oct 2026), so a hold-only animal would empty most of the wild of it. Hawk's Egg is not listed though all 6 nests stand in Eastmarch: it is Eastmarch's only already, and Eastmarch has three. Snowberries was the Pale's largest share and was left out: 450 of 1,924 in the Pale would have switched 1,474 off, where Malachite and Quicksilver switch off 88 together, and Dawnstar is a mining town.
